ov: الماس للأبد (الإنجليزية: Diamonds Are Forever) هو فيلم حركة تم إنتاجه في بريطانيا سنة 1971 . الفيلم من إخراج غاي هاملتن ، وهذا الفيلم من بطولة شون كونري.
plotEn:
To avenge Tracy, James Bond hunts Ernst Stavro Blofeld. At a facility where Blofeld lookalikes are being created through plastic surgery, Bond kills a test subject and later the "real" Blofeld.
While the assassins Mr. Wint and Mr. Kidd kill people involved in a diamond-smuggling operation, M suspects that South African diamonds are being stockpiled to depress prices by dumping and assigns Bond to uncover the smuggling ring. Impersonating the smuggler Peter Franks, Bond travels to Amsterdam to meet the contact Tiffany Case. He kills the real Franks, then switches IDs to fake his own death and assume Franks's identity. He and Tiffany go to Los Angeles, smuggling the diamonds inside Franks's corpse.
At the airport, Bond meets his Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) contact Felix Leiter and travels to Las Vegas. At a funeral home operating in the smuggling ring, Franks's body is cremated, and the diamonds are passed on to the smuggler Shady Tree. The funeral home operator, Morton Slumber, double-crosses Bond, and Wint and Kidd try to cremate him alive. However, Tree stops the process after discovering that the diamonds in Franks's body were fake, planted by Bond and the CIA. Bond tells Leiter to ship the real diamonds. At the Whyte House, a casino and hotel owned by the billionaire Willard Whyte, Tree works as a stand-up comedian but is killed by Wint and Kidd, who do not know that the diamonds were fake.
